newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Bchem, Danubius hit highs as Hungary shares rise.
newsitem.headline: Bchem, Danubius hit highs as Hungary shares rise.

text.p: Hungarian share prices extended Monday's gains and added nearly one percent on Tuesday benefiting mainly from the rising trend on major markets.
The BUX index finished at 3,784.98 points, up 30.73.
"The market rose as prices moved upwards everywhere," said Krisztina Marot of Creditanstalt Securities.
She said the macroeconomic figures released on Monday had not had an immediate positive impact, but added that the market continuously factored this in as positive background.

The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) on Monday released its preliminary figures for October and said Hungary's trade deficit was $163 million in October compared with $166 million in September, while the current account deficit was $40 million compared with $38 million in September.
Tuesday's rising trend helped two of the market's most liquid stocks, chemicals maker Borsodchem and hotel firm Danubius rise to new highs.
Borsodchem jumped to a new all-time high of 3,730 forints before it retreated to finish a shade lower at 3,725, up 50.

Danubius, ahead of an expected positive decision soon by the Competition Agency regarding the acquisition of hotel chain Hungaria Szalloda Rt by Danubius, jumped to a new record level of 3,600 forints. It ended at 3,585, up 85.
Marot said that shares in the pharmaceuticals sectors continued to move mostly together, although, she added, that Richter 's market was more liquid than that of Egis .
Egis closed at 8,900 forints, up 110 and Richter finished at 8,975 forints, up 70.
